sourcePath: sets/the-foul-realms/beta/Chaos Brawl - The Foul Realms - Beta.mse-set

cards.name: Wasted
cards.rulesText: Destroy target creature. If that creature had one or more drunk counters on it, exile it instead.
cards.flavorText: “There’s always one who goes a sip too far.”

cards.name: Nutten und Koks
cards.rulesText:
At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 2 life. Then choose one —
Create a Treasure token.
Draw a card.
cards.flavorText: “The sweetest deals are sealed with blood and gold.”

cards.name: Wixbirne
cards.rulesText:
When Wixbirne enters the battlefield, target opponent discards a card unless they pay 3 life.
{2}, {T}, Sacrifice Wixbirne: You gain 3 life.
cards.flavorText: “Even a pear can be a little jerk.”

cards.name: Couchpotato
cards.rulesText: {2}, {T}, Sacrifice Couchpotato: You gain 3 life.
cards.flavorText: “Laziness? No, no—it’s a highly cultivated lifestyle choice.”

cards.name: Puddinghead
cards.rulesText:
Defender
{2}, {T}, Sacrifice Puddinghead: You gain 3 life.
When Puddinghead dies, you lose 3 life.
cards.flavorText: “You’d think it would stop eating itself, but no.”

cards.name: Buy a Round
cards.rulesText: Create two Beer Token.
cards.flavorText: “One for me, and one for the best of friends.”

cards.name: Food Coma
cards.rulesText: When Food Coma enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until Food Coma leaves the battlefield. Create a Food token.
cards.flavorText: “Turns out the real dungeon boss was dessert.”

cards.name: Last Man Standing
cards.rulesText: Choose a creature at random. Destroy all other creatures.
cards.flavorText: “With a wobble and a slurred cheer, the last one standing was... well, mostly standing.”

cards.name: The Tipsy Ram
cards.rulesText: Drunken creatures you control get +1/+1 and have vigilance.
cards.flavorText: “A place where friends and foes can celebrate together, raising their mugs to life’s fleeting joys.”

cards.name: Toast of Comfort
cards.rulesText: Each creature gains a Drunken counter.
cards.flavorText: “Oans, zwoa, drei, g’suffa!”

cards.name: A Wife's Argument
cards.rulesText: Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {2}.
cards.flavorText: “You can keep trying, but I wouldn’t recommend it.”

cards.name: Charming Siren
cards.rulesText:
Flash
When Charming Siren enters the battlefield, obsess target creature an opponent controls.
cards.flavorText: “She looks and sounds lovely, but the depths hide a hunger no sailor can escape.”

cards.name: Circular Conversation
cards.rulesText:
Flash
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature doesn’t untap during its controller’s untap step.
cards.flavorText: “I know we’ve looped back twice, but I think round three will really clarify things.”

cards.name: Enraged Reef Leviathan
cards.rulesText: Enraged Reef Leviathan gets +3/+3 as long as there are three or more Sirens in your graveyard.
cards.flavorText: “Go ahead, play around with Sirens—he’ll make sure it’s the last game you play.”

cards.name: Mom's advice
cards.rulesText:
Choose one —
• Counter target spell.
• Surveil 2, then draw two cards.
cards.flavorText: “Son, don’t be late—I bought your favorite bananas.”

cards.name: Nagging Siren Twin
cards.rulesText: When Nagging Siren Twin enters the battlefield, create a 1/1 blue Siren creature with flying that is also named Nagging Siren Twin.
cards.flavorText: “Annoying and relentless, their song burrows into the mind like a child’s cry”

cards.name: Nutshot overload
cards.rulesText: Tap target creature and put two stun counters on it.
cards.flavorText: “Sir, I must insist... ungh!—that we discuss this with words, not whatever that was.”

cards.name: Ambush on the Throne
cards.rulesText: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn. It gets an additional -1/-1 until end of turn for each creature you control.
cards.flavorText: Privacy is a myth, and I am its latest victim.”

cards.name: Overdose
cards.rulesText:
Until end of turn, you may cast spells from your graveyard, but you lose life equal to their mana value.
At the end of the turn, if you cast three or more spells this way, you lose the game.
cards.flavorText: “It feels like power at first... but in the end, the cost is always too high.”

cards.name: Drunkard
cards.rulesText:
Haste, Drunken Tolerance 1
Drunkard enters the battlefield with three Drunken counters on it.
cards.flavorText: “One more drink and he’ll swing at anything—even shadows.”

cards.name: Drunken Warrior
cards.rulesText:
Haste
Drunken Warrior enters the battlefield with three Drunken counter on it.
Drunken counters cannot be removed from Drunken Warrior.
cards.flavorText: “He’s brave, reckless, and can barely see straight.”

cards.name: Hopsfield Vale
cards.rulesText:
({T}: Add {G} or {W} to your mana pool.)
As Hopsfield Vale enters the battlefield, you may pay 2 life. If you don’t, Hopsfield Vale enters the battlefield tapped.
cards.flavorText: “Where lush fields of hops dance in the breeze, painting a picture of dreams in the morning fog.”

cards.name: Kegbearer
cards.rulesText:
When Kegbearer, the Barrelback enters the battlefield, create two Beer token.
Drunken Tolerance 4
cards.flavorText: “He might not be the sharpest tool in the shed, but he can crush a keg with a single hand—intelligence is overrated!”

cards.name: Blunt Force Trauma
cards.rulesText: Target creature you control fights target creature you don’t control. If a creature would survive this fight, tap it. It doesn’t untap during its controller’s next untap step.
cards.flavorText: Blunt force meets blunt minds. Nature enjoys the show

cards.name: Gimme the herbs
cards.rulesText: Reveal the top four cards of your library. Put all forest cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
cards.flavorText: “The forest provides... but mostly for me!”

cards.name: Hallucinating Trip
cards.rulesText: Until end of turn, all Forests you control become 1/1 green Plant creatures with haste in addition to their other types. They’re still lands.
cards.flavorText: “Maybe I shouldn’t have taken that second puff... Wait, are the trees moving?”

cards.name: Inspiring Bard
cards.rulesText:
When Inspiring Bard enters, the battlefield, choose one —
• Bardic Inspiration — Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
• Song of Rest — You gain 3 life.
cards.flavorText: “His melody made the heart beat strong, and even the ancient trees swayed with a strong, steady rhythm.”

cards.name: Mystic Herb Buddy
cards.rulesText: If you control four or more Forests, Mystic Herb Buddy has Reach and Trample.
cards.flavorText: “It ends as a massive plant, with buds so big they can knock you out with a single hit.”

cards.name: Mystic Herb Seedling
cards.rulesText: When Mystic Herb Seedling enters the battlefield, mill three cards. You may put a land card from among the cards milled this way into your hand. If you don’t, put a +1/+1 counter on Mystic Herb Seedling.
cards.flavorText: “It starts as a seedling, but with the right care, it blossoms into something that alters your perception of the world.”

cards.name: Mystic Hotbox Hut
cards.rulesText:
Whenever you produce mana from a non-land source, put a Haze counter on Mystic Hotbox Hut.
{T}: Add {G}.
{T}, Remove three Haze counters: Create a 2/2 green Elemental creature token.
cards.flavorText: “You don’t need to take a puff, just step right in—the hotbox got you covered.”

cards.name: Brewmaster Grunthar
cards.rulesText:
Drunken Tolerance 4
When Brewmaster Grunthar enters the battlefield, create a Beer Token
cards.flavorText: “A good brew can make even the most stubborn of foes see the world a little differently.”

cards.name: Brüder Hopfenblüte
cards.rulesText:
At the beginning of each upkeep, roll a six-sided die. Create a Beer token with the result indicated below.
1 — Expired Beer
2 — Zwickl Beer
3 — Wheat Beer
4 — Dark Beer
5 — Pils Beer
6 — Bock Beer
Drunken tolerance 6

cards.name: Ice Cold Siren
cards.rulesText:
Whenever an opponent discards a card, draw a card.
{1UB},{T}: Target opponent discards a card. Activate this ability only once.
cards.flavorText: “I’m not mad; I’m just silently judging your choices.”

cards.name: Wake and Bake
cards.rulesText: Draw a card, then you may put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped. Create a Food token.
cards.flavorText: “Nothing like a little morning fog to clear the head.”

cards.name: Rotting Flesh
cards.rulesText:
When Rotting Flesh dies, you lose 2 life.
{2},{T}, Sacrifice Rotting Flesh: You gain 3 life.
cards.flavorText: “Left on the counter for just a bit too long... now it’s got a mind of its own!”

cards.name: Decaying Orchard
cards.rulesText:
({T}: Add {B} or {G} to your mana pool.)
As Decaying Orchard enters the battlefield, you may pay 2 life. If you don’t, Decaying Orchard enters the battlefield tapped.
cards.flavorText: “An orchard abandoned, where the sweet scent of pears has faded, leaving only the sorrow of neglect.”

cards.name: Distillery of Silent Death
cards.rulesText:
({T}: Add {W} or {B} to your mana pool.)
As Distillery of Silent Death enters the battlefield, you may pay 2 life. If you don’t, Distillery of Silent Death enters the battlefield tapped.
cards.flavorText: “One sip can bring visions of valor, the next, whispers of oblivion.”

cards.name: Feuerball, Junge!
cards.rulesText:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may tap any number of untapped creatures you control. This spell costs {1} less to cast for each creature tapped this way.
Explosive Singularity deals 10 damage to any target.
cards.flavorText: “So ein großer Feuerball, Junge! BAM!”

cards.name: Sacred Brewery
cards.rulesText:
({T}: Add {R} or {W} to your mana pool.)
As Sacred Brewery enters the battlefield, you may pay 2 life. If you don’t, Sacred Brewery enters the battlefield tapped.
cards.flavorText: “The foundation of the brewing art, where sacred kegs are born to cradle liquid joy.”

cards.name: Parsley Root
cards.flavorText: “Not quite a sword, but perfect for seasoning your enemies—or at least making them smell nice!”

cards.name: Celestial Waters
cards.rulesText:
When Celestial Waters enters, tap each creature and put a stun counter on each of them.
At the beginning of your turn, you may move any number of counters of your choice from one target creature onto another target creature.
cards.flavorText: “The waters cannot heal. They can only choose who bears it next.

cards.name: Gluttonous Scavenger
cards.rulesText:
Whenever you sacrifice a Food, put a +1/+1 counter on Gluttonous Scavenger.
{B/G}, Exile two cards from your graveyard: Create a Food token.
cards.flavorText: “It leaves nothing to waste, even when waste is all that’s left.”

cards.name: Brie-lliant Trapper
cards.rulesText:
Whenever Brie-lliant Trapper enters the battlefield, create a Food token.
{G}, Sacrifice a Food: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
{B}, Sacrifice a Food: Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.flavorText: “Enraged by his own smell, he can’t disguise or even resist his own trap.”

cards.name: Chaotic Kitchen
cards.rulesText:
When Chaotic Kitchen enters the battlefield, create a Food token.
Food tokens you control are 2/2 creatures with “{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 3 life” in addition to their other types.
cards.flavorText: “Clean as you go? Who has time for that!”

cards.name: Double Burn
cards.rulesText:
Double Burn deals 2 damage to any target.
Flashback—{3R} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
cards.flavorText: “Note: Something hot always burns twice.”

cards.name: Pumpkin Barrage Crew
cards.rulesText:
When Pumpkin Barrage Crew enters the battlefield, create a Food token.
{2}, Sacrifice a Food token: Pumpkin Barrage Crew deals 2 damage to target creature.
cards.flavorText: “They’ve mastered throwing pumpkins without losing their heads—most of the time.”

cards.name: Mattn, the Tasty Prince
cards.rulesText:
At the beginning of each upkeep, create a Food token.
Whenever you sacrifice a Food token, put a +1/+1 counter on Mattn, the Tasty Prince.
cards.flavorText: “Nur zum one noschn”

cards.name: Anschnly, the Vengeful Siren
cards.rulesText:
Flying
Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 2 or less, draw a card.
Whenever you cast a spell with mana value 3 or greater, Anschnly, the Vengeful Siren deals 2 damage to target creature.
cards.flavorText: “Cross her, and you’ll be singing a different tune... one of pain and regret.”

cards.name: Noxious Cloud
cards.rulesText: All creatures get -4/-4 until end of turn.
cards.flavorText: “Pears are healthy, they said.”

cards.name: Mistcliff Springs
cards.rulesText:
({T}: Add {U} or {R} to your mana pool.)
As Mistcliff Springs enters the battlefield, you may pay 2 life. If you don’t, Mistcliff Springs enters the battlefield tapped.
